contentHtml:
Windows feeling cluttered, bloated or a bit too keen on the cloud? Hate the touch-screen-style Start menu and miss the old classic one? I set up a cleaner, faster, more private Windows, at your place around Stretton and Brisbane or remotely, built around how you actually want to use the machine.

Set up the way you like it

I tailor each setup to how you want the computer to look, feel and run. Miss the old-school layout, or want proper control over privacy and performance? I strip out the apps you never asked for, turn off the cloud syncing you do not want, and bring back the familiar feel you actually like.

Take back control of your files

  • Turn off OneDrive syncing so your files stop uploading themselves in the background. If OneDrive has already caused you grief, see my OneDrive removal service.
  • Switch to a local account, no Microsoft login and no online tracking tied to it.
  • Keep files local by blocking the cloud features that would rather they were not.
  • Cut the silent background syncing for good.

Clear out the bloat

I remove the pre-installed junk, trial software, ads in the Start menu and the nagging prompts, then tidy the telemetry and privacy settings so the machine is quieter and quicker. A cloud-free setup is available if you want the computer to keep to itself entirely. If it is just running slowly, a tune-up may be the better fit.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
